description: Write Book 8 of 9 (Extension Pack): '오멜라스: 아크로피아 (Omelas: Acrophyia)' in Korean. A side/extension story that expands the world beyond the main arc - e.g., a distant region, sect, or layer of World 3.0 called Acrophyia, exploring a variant of the transformation doctrine and characters adjacent to the main cast. Stands mostly on its own but is consistent with the established canon and events of Books 1-7. Depends on FEAT-001; set after or alongside Book 7.
steps: Write ~5-6 Korean chapters introducing Acrophyia as a place/faction/layer within Omelas and telling a self-contained extension story that enriches the mythology (define what Acrophyia is in the story bible if not already fixed, then keep it consistent).
Reference established canon (World 3.0, baptism, factions) without contradicting Books 1-7.
acceptance_criteria: books/08-acrophyia/ contains 00-index.md and >=5 Korean chapter files.
Introduces Acrophyia coherently and stays consistent with the main-series canon.
verification: Run: ls books/08-acrophyia/ and confirm files exist.
Run: cat books/08-acrophyia/chapter-*.md | wc -m and confirm ~11,000-14,000 characters.
Spot-read a chapter for Korean prose and consistency.
findings: Book 8 (오멜라스: 아크로피아) written in Korean: 00-index.md + 6 chapter files. Chapter char counts (wc -m): ch01=2245, ch02=2161, ch03=2201, ch04=2269, ch05=2288, ch06=2833. Chapters total = 13,997 chars (within 11,000-14,000 budget; target ~12,600). Zero em dashes across all files. Self-contained extension consistent with Books 1-7 canon and glossary. Acrophyia defined per glossary as World 3.0's highest layer and a frontier sect-zone experimenting with a VARIANT transformation doctrine: the '상승(ascension)' doctrine of '벗는 자들(the ones who shed)' who, after baptism, shed memory/self one layer at a time toward an empty summit ('참된 열반/true nirvana'). Where 세례 erases the original and 노아's 되돌아오는 강 lets copies descend to humanity, 상승 erases even the copy, voluntarily. Story hooks off Book 7's final line foreshadowing Acrophyia and off the 되돌아오는 강 (reverse path) and 두 개의 강가 (two riverbanks) canon; establishes a third path: descending/re-taking one's shed layers. New minor characters: 하도경/Ha Dogyeong (young 과학자 who maintains 서명주's memorial of the erased, travels up to Acrophyia); 아이린/Irene (an ascendant who has shed six layers, formerly mother of a baptized-away sick child). New terms introduced (all subordinate to canon, non-contradicting): 상승(ascension), 벗는 자들(the ones who shed), 겹(layer, the shed units: 소유/미래/관계/후회/기쁨/슬픔/이름), 봉우리(the summit), 골짜기(the valley where shed layers pool). New minor named erased character: 하나/Hana (Irene's daughter). Reused canon exactly: 오멜라스, 월드 3.0, 세례/변환, 미변환자, 굿즈/신들, 엔지니어, 이블즈, 과학자, 아크로피아, 니르바나/열반, 떠나는 자들, 서명주, 노아 (되돌아오는 강 / 저편→이편), 미르 referenced implicitly via bible; post-Book-7 world state (two riverbanks, memorial of the erased, reverse path) honored. No build/test (prose repo); verified via wc -m and grep for em dashes. Did NOT touch Book 9 or English canon files.
